10k.summary: Self-described preclinical-stage biotech focused on AI-discovered antibodies for obesity/cardiometabolic disease. 10-K (FY2025) describes IBIO-600 (anti-myostatin) in IND-enabling studies; first human trials anticipated late FY2026/early FY2027. IBIO-610 (Activin E) at development candidate selection.

website.summary: Public pipeline shows IBIO-610 and IBIO-600 in IND-enabling stage; bispecific Myostatin x Activin A and amylin receptor antibody in optimization; one undisclosed AstralBio target in discovery

ctgov.note: PHI-101 trials (NCT04678102, NCT04842370) are sponsored by Seoul National University Hospital with Pharos iBio Co., Ltd. (a separate Korean entity, not iBio Inc.) and are excluded as partner/unrelated. NCT07487376 is iBio Inc.'s own IBIO-600 P1 SAD.

pipeline.modality: Long-acting humanized monoclonal antibody (subcutaneous, extended half-life)
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from AstralBio (Myostatin License Agreement, Dec 2024)

indications.indication: Overweight / Obesity (lean-mass-preserving therapy, intended to be combined with or follow GLP-1 agonists)
indications.trial_name: Single-dose SAD study of IBIO-600 in overweight/obese adults
indications.trial_design: Single ascending dose, randomized, placebo-controlled; safety, tolerability, PK, PD
indications.trial_status: Not Yet Recruiting (planned start April 2026; primary completion May 2027)
key_milestones: First in-human dosing planned 2026; primary completion May 2027

excluded_preclinical: IBIO-610 (Activin E antibody) — development candidate, IND-enabling planned
Myostatin x Activin A bispecific antibody — late discovery / in vitro POC
Amylin receptor agonist antibody (AstralBio collaboration) — in vivo POC, preclinical
excluded_partner_owned: PHI-101 (NCT04678102 platinum-resistant ovarian cancer P1; NCT04842370 R/R AML P1) — sponsored by Seoul National University Hospital with Pharos iBio Co., Ltd. (separate Korean entity, not iBio Inc.)
